Vivaldi: Multi-Agent Physiological TS Interpretation (2026)
edges.note: Vivaldi extends single-agent TS reasoning to a multi-agent architecture with specialized clinical roles.

edges.target_label: Vivaldi: Multi-Agent Physiological TS Interpretation (2026)
edges.note: Vivaldi operationalizes biosignal FM concepts via a cooperative multi-agent pipeline for clinical interpretation.

edges.target_label: Vivaldi: Multi-Agent Physiological TS Interpretation (2026)
edges.note: Where Sensor2Text trains a sensor-language bridge, Vivaldi avoids alignment training by distributing interpretation across agents.

edges.target_label: Uncertainty-Aware Foundation Models for Clinical Data (2026)
edges.note: Where the biosignals survey describes clinical foundation models that emit a single deterministic embedding, this paper changes the output object from a point to a set-valued distribution that marks unobserved structure as epistemic uncertainty.

edges.source_label: Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners (MAE, He 2022)
edges.target_label: Uncertainty-Aware Foundation Models for Clinical Data (2026)
edges.note: This paper keeps the MAE-style reconstruction objective but combines it with contrastive alignment and a distributional regularizer so the patient representation is a distribution rather than a point.

edges.source_label: How Mask Matters: Masked Autoencoders Theory (Zhang 2023)
edges.target_label: Uncertainty-Aware Foundation Models for Clinical Data (2026)
edges.note: The reconstruction term this theory work analyzes is retained, while the model adds a distributional regularizer because sparse, irregular clinical data make a single deterministic embedding overconfident.

edges.target_label: AnyPPG: An ECG-Guided PPG Foundation Model Trained on Over 100,000 Hours of Recordings
edges.note: Where the Gu survey laid out single-modality biosignal pretraining, AnyPPG adds cross-signal guidance by using synchronized ECG to supervise the PPG encoder at scale.

edges.target_label: AnyPPG: An ECG-Guided PPG Foundation Model Trained on Over 100,000 Hours of Recordings
edges.note: AnyPPG extends the single-modality biosignal foundation-model approach of HeAR to paired PPG and ECG, using the cleaner ECG timing to constrain the noisier PPG representation.

edges.source_label: Foundation Models for Biosignals: A Survey (Gu 2025)
edges.target_label: CAP: Towards PPG Universal Representation Learning with Patient-level Supervision (2026)
edges.note: Where the biosignal survey learned PPG representations from the signal alone, CAP adds patient-level clinical text as the supervision anchor, because similar waveforms can come from patients in different physiological states.

edges.source_label: Sensor2Text: NL Interactions for Activity Tracking (Chen 2024)
edges.target_label: CAP: Towards PPG Universal Representation Learning with Patient-level Supervision (2026)
edges.note: Where Sensor2Text aligned activity sensors to natural-language activity descriptions, CAP aligns PPG to structured patient-level clinical semantics distilled from records.

edges.source_label: How Mask Matters: Masked Autoencoders Theory (Zhang 2023)
edges.target_label: CAP: Towards PPG Universal Representation Learning with Patient-level Supervision (2026)
edges.note: CAP keeps a masked reconstruction objective in the spirit of the masked-autoencoder analysis, but pairs it with clinical anchoring and a longer temporal window.

edges.target_label: AtomiMed: Hierarchical Atomic Fact-Checking for Medical Report Evaluation (2026)
edges.note: Where Med-VQA Hallucination measured hallucination on question answering, AtomiMed turns fact-level checking into an evaluation metric for full report generation, decomposing a report into atomic clinical facts and verifying each.

edges.target_label: AtomiMed: Hierarchical Atomic Fact-Checking for Medical Report Evaluation (2026)
edges.note: Verifiable Physio Reasoning pushed checkable outputs on the generation side; AtomiMed applies the same make-each-claim-checkable principle to the evaluation side.

edges.target_label: MRPO: Step-Aware RL for Medical Multimodal Reasoning (2026)
edges.note: Where DeepSeek-R1 rewards only the final outcome, MRPO shapes the reward at the level of individual reasoning steps, because outcome-only credit assignment is too sparse for clinical images.

edges.target_label: MRPO: Step-Aware RL for Medical Multimodal Reasoning (2026)
edges.note: Where standard GRPO treats all tokens in a wrong trajectory equally, MRPO weights earlier invalid steps more heavily, because an early mistake is what makes the later steps wrong.

edges.target_label: MRPO: Step-Aware RL for Medical Multimodal Reasoning (2026)
edges.note: Med-VQA Hallucination measured confident but wrong statements in medical VQA; MRPO targets that failure mode by fixing the early reasoning step that starts the cascade, dropping early-stage failures from 64.0% to 13.0%.

edges.target_label: Discrete Diffusion Language Models for Radiology Report Drafting (2026)
edges.note: Where DDPM denoises continuous image pixels, this paper denoises in the discrete token space of text and shows the approach is competitive with autoregression on medical VQA.

edges.target_label: Discrete Diffusion Language Models for Radiology Report Drafting (2026)
edges.note: The faster deterministic sampling of DDIM is the line of work behind the 3.5 to 4.4 times decode speedup reported here.

edges.target_label: Discrete Diffusion Language Models for Radiology Report Drafting (2026)
edges.note: LoRA is held identical across the diffusion and autoregressive models so the generative paradigm is the only variable in the comparison.

edges.target_label: Discrete Diffusion Language Models for Radiology Report Drafting (2026)
edges.note: Med-VQA Hallucination is the prior evidence on medical VQA answer quality that sets the benchmark setting for this comparison.

edges.target_label: CLeaD: Layer-wise Cross-Lingual Depression Detection from Speech (2026)
edges.note: Where HeAR learned strong health-acoustic features within a single language, CLeaD asks whether such representations carry across languages and aligns English and Mandarin embeddings into one clinical space.

edges.source_label: Foundation Models for Biosignals: A Survey (Gu 2025)
edges.target_label: CLeaD: Layer-wise Cross-Lingual Depression Detection from Speech (2026)
edges.note: Where the Biosignals survey mapped within-domain foundation models, CLeaD tests the cross-lingual transfer those works left open and documents a speaker-leakage evaluation pitfall.

edges.target_label: CLeaD: Layer-wise Cross-Lingual Depression Detection from Speech (2026)
edges.note: Where Health-LLM treated health signals as tokens for one language model, CLeaD imports cross-lingual supervised contrastive alignment into clinical bio-acoustics.

edges.target_label: Cura 1T: Specialized Model for Agentic Healthcare (2026)
edges.note: Where Liu 2023 showed a general model answers health questions from a few examples, Cura 1T builds a healthcare-specialized model whose data mixture is rewritten each round from its own benchmark failures.

edges.source_label: CounselBench: LLM Benchmarking in Mental Health (Li 2025)
edges.target_label: Cura 1T: Specialized Model for Agentic Healthcare (2026)
edges.note: Where CounselBench measured where language models fail in mental-health advice, Cura 1T turns such measured failures into the training signal itself through a closed human-gated self-evolution loop.

edges.source_label: Foundation Models for Biosignals: A Survey (Gu 2025)
edges.target_label: Cura 1T: Specialized Model for Agentic Healthcare (2026)
edges.note: Where Gu 2025 catalogued fixed biosignal encoders, Cura 1T is an agentic system whose data mixture changes each round, placing it on the self-improving-system branch rather than the fixed-encoder branch.

edges.source_label: How Mask Matters: Masked Autoencoders Theory (Zhang 2023)
edges.target_label: MorphologyFM: A Foundation Model for Morphology-Aware Representation Learning from ECG and Pulse Oximetry Waveforms (2026)
edges.note: Where the masked-autoencoder analysis masks random patches and rewards value reconstruction, MorphologyFM masks with waveform morphology in mind and adds a contrastive objective, because the diagnostic content of a physiological waveform is in its shape, not its average level.

edges.source_label: Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners (MAE, He 2021)
edges.target_label: MorphologyFM: A Foundation Model for Morphology-Aware Representation Learning from ECG and Pulse Oximetry Waveforms (2026)
edges.note: MorphologyFM keeps masked reconstruction pretraining but targets waveform morphology rather than image pixels and pairs it with cross-modal contrastive alignment across ECG and SpO2.

edges.source_label: Foundation Models for Biosignals: A Survey (Gu 2025)
edges.target_label: MorphologyFM: A Foundation Model for Morphology-Aware Representation Learning from ECG and Pulse Oximetry Waveforms (2026)
edges.note: Where the Gu survey describes mostly single-signal biosignal pretraining, MorphologyFM extends the program to paired cross-modal ECG plus SpO2 pretraining with explicit cross-modal alignment.

edges.source_label: Foundation Models for Biosignals: A Survey (Gu 2025)
edges.target_label: Continuous-Latent Predictive Modeling with Semantic Alignment for EEG-Language Foundation Models (BLPM) (2026)
edges.note: The survey framed reconstruction quality as a poor proxy for downstream clinical utility; BLPM acts on that framing by predicting latent semantics instead of the waveform.

edges.source_label: Sensor2Text: NL Interactions for Activity Tracking (Chen 2024)
edges.target_label: Continuous-Latent Predictive Modeling with Semantic Alignment for EEG-Language Foundation Models (BLPM) (2026)
edges.note: Sensor2Text showed a sensor encoder can be queried conversationally; BLPM moves that bridge from wearable activity streams to neural signals and from post-hoc alignment to alignment as pretraining.

edges.target_label: Continuous-Latent Predictive Modeling with Semantic Alignment for EEG-Language Foundation Models (BLPM) (2026)
edges.note: SensorLM is the closest sensor-language precedent at scale; BLPM changes the modality to EEG and the pooling to multi-query decomposition so several unrelated clinical labels can read different components.

edges.source_label: Foundation Models for Biosignals: A Survey (Gu 2025)
edges.target_label: FOUND-AF: Benchmarking ECG Foundation Models for Atrial Fibrillation Detection (2026)
edges.note: The survey collected what each bio-signal foundation model claims under its own evaluation setup and therefore could not say which encoder is better; FOUND-AF tests nine of them under one protocol and produces a ranking.

edges.target_label: FOUND-AF: Benchmarking ECG Foundation Models for Atrial Fibrillation Detection (2026)
edges.note: HeAR validated one encoder by downstream transfer against baselines its own authors selected; FOUND-AF fixes the downstream classifier and the split policy across all nine encoders so the comparison isolates representation quality rather than fine-tuning effort.

edges.source_label: Self-supervised Learning for HAR with 700K Person-days (Yuan 2024)
edges.target_label: FOUND-AF: Benchmarking ECG Foundation Models for Atrial Fibrillation Detection (2026)
edges.note: Yuan 2024 established large-scale self-supervised pretraining for wearable sensor streams; FOUND-AF adds the evaluation-side control that line lacked, namely recording-level grouped cross-validation, which removes the within-subject leakage that inflates most published ECG numbers.
